memory_candidates: BracketFormula.splitAt_combine proof: 4-case split on (i.val = 0 vs > 0) x (n - i.val = 0 vs > 0). Key tactic patterns: dif_pos/dif_neg for dite simplification, congr 1 + simp only [Fin.ext_iff] + omega for Fin-indexed type equality, congrArg for witness function equality.

CRITICAL: The peel-off-first-witness approach (Lemma 5.3 pattern) does NOT generalize to Lemma 5.1. Our BracketFormula has ALL witnesses interior to (z0, z1) with NO endpoint conditions. The paper places alpha_0 at endpoint z_0 itself. Finding first alpha_0-occurrence r0 gives not-alpha_0 on (z0, r0) but NOT beta_0 (segmentTypes 0) on (z0, r0), so splitAt_combine at index 0 cannot reconstruct the bracket.
neg_bracket_zero_is_vbracket: For BracketFormula 0, negation = exists y with not-beta_0(y), a 1-witness bracket with pointType = beta_0.neg, segmentTypes = top. Sorry-free.
For Fin arithmetic in IntervalPattern proofs: Fin.val_lt_val does NOT exist. Use Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val or Fin.lt_def instead.
